kept_lines: File your 2025 taxes with a business tax expert powered by TurboTax. They ensure 100% accuracy and review your return to lock in your maximum tax savings.
Tax experts from TurboTax are available year round to help you manage your business taxes. Reach out to your expert whenever you need.
Get matched with a local tax expert who knows your industry. Connect online or at a TurboTax office near you.
March 16, 2026, is the 2025 tax return submission deadline for S-Corp (Form 1120-S) or a partnership (Form 1065). If necessary, you can request an extension and have until September 15, 2026.
April 15, 2026 is the 2025 tax return submission deadline for a sole proprietor (Form 1040 and Schedule C). If necessary, you can request an extension and have until October 15, 2026.
Accept credit cards and bank transfers in the invoice with QuickBooks Payments, get status updates and reminders.
Know how your business is doing with sales, accounts receivable, and accounts payable reports.*
Track all your projects in one place, track labor costs, payroll and expenses.
Create invoices, enter, edit, and send multiple invoices faster.**

TurboTax Experts for Business are accessible via phone, chat, or one-way video if you need assistance. During tax season, TurboTax experts are available 7 days a week from 5 AM to 9 PM PT from January 5 to April 20, 2026, and 5 AM to 12 AM on April 15, 2026. Outside of tax season, regular hours are Monday through Friday, 5am to 5pm PT. Near the September and October extension deadlines, we will resume extended hours of operations including evening and weekend hours. Service, area of expertise, experience levels, and wait times vary, and are subject to restriction and change without notice. Unlimited access to TurboTax experts is included with all Intuit Business Tax Expert products.
Audits by the IRS can be random. If, by chance, your business return is audited, you won't have to worry because audit protection is included at no extra cost.
